import re, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('openviking-data/viking/default/user/default/memories')
pt = re.compile(r'(configuracao|prevencao|requisicao|_de_|_em_|dialogo|validacao|paginacao|estilo_de|layout_de|geracao_|gestao_|isolamento_|navegacao_|nomenclatura_)', re.I)

def topic_name(text):
    m = re.search(r'"topic"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', text)
    if m:
        t = re.sub(r'^主题标题:\s*', '', m.group(1).strip())
        for c in '<>:"/\\|?*':
            t = t.replace(c, '_')
        return t[:120].strip()
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.strip() and not ln.startswith('---')]
    for ln in lines:
        if ln.startswith('# '):
            return ln[2:][:120]
        if ln.startswith('- ') and re.search(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]', ln):
            return ln[2:][:80]
    return None

migs = []
seen = {}
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*.md')):
    if '_archive' in str(p) or not pt.search(p.name):
        continue
    rel = p.relative_to(root)
    parts = rel.parts
    vdir = 'viking://user/default/memories/' + '/'.join(parts[:-1])
    old_uri = vdir + '/' + p.name
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    base = topic_name(text) or p.stem
    fn = base + '.md'
    if fn in seen:
        fn = base + '_' + hashlib.sha256(old_uri.encode()).hexdigest()[:6] + '.md'
    seen[fn] = old_uri
    new_uri = vdir + '/' + fn
    if new_uri == old_uri:
        continue
    migs.append({'old_uri': old_uri, 'new_uri': new_uri, 'old_name': p.name, 'new_name': fn})
out = Path.home() / '.dsh/cache/memory-audit/pt-to-zh-migrations.json'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps({'count': len(migs), 'migrations': migs}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(str(out), 'count', len(migs))

tool_input.command:
PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
p = Path.home() / '.dsh/cache/memory-audit/pt-to-zh-migrations.json'
data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
ok, fail = [], []
for i, m in enumerate(data['migrations'], 1):
    cmd = ['ov', 'mv', m['old_uri'], m['new_uri'], '-o', 'json']
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=180)
    except Exception as e:
        fail.append({**m, 'error': str(e)})
        continue
    if r.returncode == 0:
        ok.append(m)
    else:
        fail.append({**m, 'rc': r.returncode, 'err': (r.stderr or r.stdout)[:500]})
    if i % 10 == 0:
        print(f'progress {i}/{len(data["migrations"])}', flush=True)
out = Path.home() / '.dsh/cache/memory-audit/pt-to-zh-apply-result.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps({'ok': len(ok), 'fail': len(fail), 'failed': fail, 'sample_ok': ok[:3]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print('OK', len(ok), 'FAIL', len(fail), 'result', out)
if fail:
    sys.exit(1)
PY
